hooks.command: ulimit -t 5 2>/dev/null; r="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/.vbw/record.json"; g=/dev/null; d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/.vbw/runtime/glance.json"; [ -f "$r" ] && [ -f "$d" ] && [ -r "$d" ] && [ "$d" -nt "$r" ] && g="$d"; o=0; [ -e "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/.vbw/runtime/run-open" ] && o=1; jq -nc --rawfile glance "$g" --arg root "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}" --arg open "$o" -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard-bash.jq" - "$r" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/end.json" 2>/dev/null || { [ "$o" = 1 ] && { echo "VBW guard: the guard failed while a run is open, so this call is blocked. Next: run vbw doctor to see why, then retry" >&2; exit 2; }; true; }
jq -c -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/approve-ask.jq" 2>/dev/null | { IFS= read -r in && bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/approve-ask.sh" "$in"; } 2>/dev/null || true
